info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Payments Payments Disputes-v2-spec
info.description: The Dispute Management API enables users to retrieve information regarding payment disputes. This endpoint provides access to detailed records of payment disputes, allowing businesses to monitor and manage any challenges arising from transaction discrepancies. Typical consumers include financial service providers and merchants looking to assess the status of disputes and take necessary actions. Utilizing this API can improve customer relations and enhance the overall payment processing experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific payment dispute. You can use this information to understand the nature of the dispute and take appropriate actions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding payment disputes. It should contain the necessary parameters to filter and specify the dispute details being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning dispute details.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving payment dispute operations.

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the reference number associated with the dispute.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the dispute operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving payment dispute operations.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing audit information for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance and efficiency of the API request handling.
